sources.fullCitation: Archiwum Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego, Bronisław Kaper student file, RP 6854. Aggregate archival source for documents from Kaper’s University of Warsaw student file, including the young portrait, University of Warsaw matriculation and study records, the police certificate of 21 April 1920 recording his religion as Mosaic, and the baptism record/certificate concerning St Alexander’s Church, 17 July 1920. No public URL; used with permission / archival consultation.

media.title: Bronisław Kaper’s University of Warsaw student record book — opening folios, 1920
media.description: Opening folios of Bronisław Kaper’s student record book (“Wykaz wykładów i ćwiczeń”) at the University of Warsaw, Faculty of Law and Political Sciences. The spread includes his student portrait and matriculation information. University of Warsaw Archives, Bronisław Kaper student file, RP 6854, fols. 38–39.

timelineEvents.title: Formal matriculation at the University of Warsaw
timelineEvents.label: 6 Feb 1920 · Formal UW matriculation
timelineEvents.shortDescription: After the one-semester delay documented separately, Kaper was formally entered in the Faculty of Law album at the University of Warsaw.
timelineEvents.longDescription: This event now records the formal matriculation rather than the earlier October 1919 application. Kaper was entered in the Faculty of Law and Political Sciences album on 6 February 1920, under album number 6854.
